item.title: Moulin Rouge! The Musical Returns In 2027
item.description: Global Creatures announced that Moulin Rouge! The Musical will open at the Sydney Lyric in March 2027, with an all-new Australian cast, delivering the same internationally acclaimed spectacle fans know and love. In 2025, seven productions of the hit show lit up stages across the globe. To date, over 12 million theatregoers worldwide have experienced the spectacular, and the original Broadway soundtrack has had 169 million streams on Spotify and leading music streamers. item.title: Green Room Awards 43rd Annual
item.description: The 43rd Annual Green Room Awards were presented in Melbourne on March 16. Major winners at the the peer voted awards include: Beetlejuice the Musical which took out four awards in the commercial musical category including production of the year. The James Terry Collective production of Tarzan the stage musical won three awards in the independent musical theatre category including production of the year.
